limitations: Finite pose, surface, ray and material samples do not establish continuous clearance, manufacturing tolerances, load/strength/fatigue, aerodynamics or airworthiness.
All distances use uncalibrated concept-model units. Main seam is approximately75% narrower; the local smooth trailing-tip relief is explicitly separate.
Historical unchanged-pair results are inherited after exact source and decoded runtime geometry/normals/topology/TRS/animation proof; they are not described as reruns.
Fourteen existing fixed-interface observation regions are explicitly revised and remeasured as changed skin engages retained supports; original SAT/material/finite-area thresholds are retained.
Actual SDK/HTTP/SSE/production GLB verification is distinct from browser/WebGL/touch/device testing.
